title: EcoCard: New Customer Promo - Earn Bonus Sustainability Points
summary: EcoCard New Customer Promo runs 2025-08-01 through 2025-12-15. New customers can earn $2,000 sustainability points by spending at least $5,000 in eligible purchases within the first 1 month of account opening (points post after the qualifying period closes and transactions clear).
faqs: What are the offer dates for the EcoCard new customer sustainability points promotion?
How much do I need to spend, and within what timeframe, to earn the bonus?
Am I required to be a new customer, and must my account be in good standing when the bonus is awarded?
When will the $2,000 sustainability points post after I qualify?
Which transactions don’t count toward the $5,000 spend threshold (e.g., fees, balance transfers, cash equivalents, returns/chargebacks)?
Where can I track my progress toward the $5,000 requirement?
keywords: Within first 1 month of account opening
Bonus posts after qualifying period closes
Returns and chargebacks reduce qualifying spend
